## The voice chain's picker. Pure C: the host harness in tools/chain_harness compiles the same
## sources for x86.
add_library(fph_chain_picker INTERFACE)
target_sources(fph_chain_picker
    INTERFACE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/chain_picker.c
)
target_include_directories(fph_chain_picker
    INTERFACE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/api
)
target_link_libraries(fph_chain_picker
    INTERFACE
        lib_xcore_math
)

## src/chain_picker_tables.h is generated by satellite's prototype/chain/gen_g3_tables.py.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../chain_beams/tables_check.cmake)
chain_tables_check(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/chain_picker_tables.h CHAIN_PICKER_TABLES_SHA256)

add_library(fph::chain_picker ALIAS fph_chain_picker)
